text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Bad electoral results force Juppe to resign
- (Official government spokesman) Rodriguez now says (Antena 3 TV chairman) Asensio threatened him, but offers no proof.
- A Teacher faces two years in prison for forging an exam paper to help a student to pass.
EL MUNDO
- (France Prime Minister) Juppe offer his head so that the centre right can remain in power.
- Spanish Popular Party expected to increase its advantage over PSOE, according to Centro de Investigation Sociologicas.
- IU party critisized PDNI to back the labour reform pact
- Stock market get closer to 600.
- (Government spokesman) Rodriguez says Asensio threatened him, and (former Prime Minister) Gonzalez is manipulating him.
DIARIO 16
- Rodriguez story -- This man is a liar.
ABC
- (Official spokesman) Rodriguez unmasked Gonzalez as the scriptwriter and the director of the alleged threat campaign.
CINCO DIAS
- Latest OECD's advise: please, Mister Aznar, liberalise.
- Investors punished France.
- Bankinter gives cash and shares to its workers as incentives.
- Complaints against tax inspectors increased.
EXPANSION
- Stock market reached the level of 570 points.
- (France Prime Minister) Juppe resigned while public firms suffered.
- Gas Natural to make a free shareholders capital increase of 52 billion pesetas.
- Spanish bank BCH wants to remain core shareholder in CEPSA.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Share market scored 570 points, pulled higher by star shares.
- Banco Central Hispano's and Union Fenosa's chairman applauded the policy of Aznar's government.
- Banco Santander saves 4 billion pesetas joining money market dealer and risk
-- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
